releaseThreshold.basis: A material GBIF source-family milestone moved 1737 unique county-species pairs across Washington, Maryland, and Arizona, added 480 verified-present pairs, closed 75 protocol cells, and produced three reusable immutable statewide partitions.

recoveryAudit.qualification: The old jobs were bound to base 20bb and lacked exact executable output lineage. Their broad scope was not treated as a cache. No provider request was issued for those stale contracts.

manualInterventions: Cancelled three first-issued leases before staging or provider access when the expanded acquisition commands did not bind the attempt-telemetry wrapper required by the contract.
Reissued corrected jobs, preflights, leases, and queue entries with the telemetry-bound expanded command. The cancelled contracts made zero provider calls.
Corrected the national GBIF planner integrity test to select a nonempty state with positive net-new movement instead of assuming the first nonempty state must move after new integrations.

requestTelemetry.qualification: Every leased pair received a complete explicit outcome. Source silence, rejection, and no qualifying specimen evidence remained researched-unresolved and created no negative determination.

grossEventVolume.qualification: Gross event volume is reported separately from 1737 unique final-matrix pair movements.

MD.overlapQualification: Ten positive results and 38 no-qualifying-evidence outcomes were already researched, so 600 completed outcomes produced 552 unique final-matrix movements.

AZ.overlapQualification: The exact leased scope intentionally completed 165 already-researched pairs to preserve deterministic statewide partitioning; they are excluded from net movement.

applicabilityAndDenominatorMovement.qualification: No applicability or denominator change is counted as county research movement in this round.

expectedVersusActual.qualification: Net movement matched the semantic preflight exactly. Six additional provider calls were complete occurrence-pagination pages. Positive yield substantially exceeded the historical estimate; the estimate is retained as a miss rather than revised after the fact.

releaseOverhead.knownSequentialReleaseQualification: Approximately 31.0 minutes of retained measured sequential work. Readiness generation, dashboard generation, local browser QA, production browser QA, and the planner-test repair were completed but their wall durations were not retained and are not fabricated.

externalVerification.runtimeLogQualification: The configured Vercel CLI returned zero error-level rows for the exact deployment and verification window. Runtime confidence also includes provider READY and exact source metadata, successful public routes, selected byte parity, and fresh browser behavior.

processLesson.lesson: An executable acquisition contract must bind attempt telemetry before staging or network activity, and planned pair volume must be netted against the current matrix before ranking.
applied: The first three leases were cancelled before provider access when expanded commands omitted the telemetry wrapper, then reissued only after corrected dry-runs matched exact ordered scopes and deterministic paths.
Eleven stale planned jobs were cancelled after current-matrix reconciliation showed only 574 of 2103 pairs remained not researched and no exact recoverable pages existed.
The portfolio used one provenance-bound taxonomy cache across three jurisdictions, preventing 40 repeated species-match requests.
The national planner integrity test now finds a nonempty state with positive net-new movement instead of relying on a stale state-order assumption.

nextRankedSourcePortfolio.reason: Search immutable runs, exact provider pages, verified taxonomy identities, and provider-native bulk options across every jurisdiction before any new live state acquisition. This outranks queued state work because reuse can move multiple jurisdictions with lower request and review cost.
Best remaining combination of bounded net movement and measured positive yield, with strong taxonomy reuse and lower structural risk than Montana.
Higher expected movement than Nevada but lower measured positive yield; it remains ahead of zero-yield tails.
Strong net movement and protocol closure with existing source-family lineage, but less positive yield than Nevada and Oregon.
Largest known remaining net scope, ranked after smaller positive-yield jurisdictions because its prior source-family yield was zero.
Meaningful movement remains, but prior memory pressure makes per-taxon child processes, streaming parsing, or verified cache recovery a prerequisite to another lease.

automatedNationalAcquisition.qualification: This is isolated worker process time for the measured GBIF topology, not an end-to-end completion date and not a forecast for other sources.

stateSpecificResearch.qualification: Each jurisdiction needs a current semantic preflight for overlap, pagination, taxonomy reuse, and review burden; no blended duration is defensible.

applicabilityReview.qualification: Applicability remains a separate evidence class and this round measured no applicability-review rate.

blockedExceptions.qualification: These require source-specific or exact human review and cannot be extrapolated from automated acquisition.

freshnessWork.qualification: This round closed current cells but did not measure a general freshness-remediation rate.

releaseOverhead.qualification: Approximately 31.0 minutes of retained measured sequential generation, validation, push, and one deployment, excluding completed but unretained browser and dashboard durations.
